question: Is a subgrouping of the Malagasy dialects entered?
chosen_reading: No: all lects sit directly under Proto-Malagasy. Adelaar (2013) rejects Dez's (1963) li/ti division on methodological and distributional grounds (li and ti are retentions), finds the lexicostatistical classifications (Vérin, Kottak & Gorlin 1969; Mahdi 1988; Simon 2006) weak, and only tentatively groups the northern dialects with the central and eastern ones (Northern-Central-Eastern) against the southwestern ones, leaving the western dialects (Sakalava, West Bara) open (pp. 476-477). The *li > di, *ti > tsi and final *i/*e rows mark the evidence on the lects.
alternatives: Enter a Northern-Central-Eastern group and a Southwestern group; or Glottolog's Malagasic subgroups (North-Central, Southwestern).
